stories.title: New offence of assaulting a retail worker among Crime and Policing Act measures
stories.summary: A package of new crime laws affecting town centres, retailers, vulnerable adults and online knife sales received Royal Assent this week, with North Wales Police set to operate the new powers across Flintshire. The Crime and Policing Act creates more than 70 new measures across England and Wales. Most will come into force in stages

stories.title: Burglary gang who targeted elderly Broughton couple jailed at Mold Crown Court
stories.summary: A burglary gang who targeted elderly and vulnerable victims across Flintshire and Wrexham have been jailed at Mold Crown Court for a combined total of almost 10 years. stories.title: ASDA recalls Beer Battered Cod Fishcakes over plastic and metal fears
stories.summary: ASDA is recalling Exceptional by ASDA Beer Battered Cod Fishcakes over a warning that the product may contain pieces of plastic or metal. stories.title: Heritage groups withdraw objections to revised Soughton Hall extension plans
stories.summary: Plans to build a permanent extension to Flintshire’s historic Soughton Hall have been redrawn to better fit in with the character of the venue. stories.title: Met Office forecasts mixed weather for May Bank Holiday in north Wales
stories.summary: The Bank Holiday weekend is shaping up to be a wet one across Flintshire, with forecasts of drizzle on Saturday, rain through Sunday and a cool, cloudy Bank Holiday Monday.
